description: Invalid integration profiles for the profile validator. Each file is spec/v1.0/profiles/example.profile.json with one defect. Validate a file against spec/v1.0/profiles/integration-profile.schema.json and, only when it is schema-valid, apply the profile lint of spec/v1.0/profiles/README.md, with spec/ as the base of fixture paths and spec/v1.0/fixtures/manifest.json as the registry of fixture ids. Each file must fail with exactly the listed errors: instance_pointer is the RFC 6901 location in the file, keyword the failing JSON Schema keyword, lint the failing lint rule.

cases.reason: the first bypass path has no control
unsupported_forms is empty; a profile states at least one wider claim it does not establish
the fixture id is registered in the manifest (it is this file's own entry), but its path names no file under spec/
the attribute source names the freshness entry Directory account state, but the entry's source is Directory account state (enabled or disabled); the name must match exactly
